Package ed.inf.adbs.blazedb

Class SplitExpressionDeparser

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jsqlparser.util.deparser.ExpressionDeParser
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.SplitExpressionDeparser
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.sf.jsqlparser.expression.ExpressionVisitor
public class SplitExpressionDeparser extends net.sf.jsqlparser.util.deparser.ExpressionDeParser
SplitExpressionDeparser is a subclass of ExpressionDeParser responsible for processing SQL comparison expressions (e.g., equality, greater than, less than) and organizing them into single table and join expressions. It handles the analysis of comparison expressions between columns or literals and categorizes them based on whether they involve columns from the same table or different tables.

It divides the comparison expressions into two types:

  • Single expressions: Comparisons where both operands belong to the same table.
  • Join expressions: Comparisons where the operands belong to different tables.

Additionally, it provides functionality to check if an expression always evaluates to false (e.g., a comparison like 4 = 5).

    • processExpression

      public void processExpression(net.sf.jsqlparser.expression.operators.relational.ComparisonOperator operator)
      Processes a comparison expression and categorizes it into either a single expression or a join expression.

      This method checks if the operands of the comparison operator are columns, literals, or a combination thereof, and stores the expression in either the singleExpressions or joinExpressions map accordingly.

      Parameters:
      operator - the comparison operator to process (e.g., EqualsTo, GreaterThan)
